translations.web: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
translations.bsb: When Jesus saw them, He said, “Go, show yourselves to the priests.” And as they were on their way, they were cleansed.
translations.kjv: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
translations.asv: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go and show yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, as they went, they were cleansed.
